name: popover
blurb: Button expands to a form with textarea, label, and action buttons.
description: A custom popover built from Framer Motion that morphs from a button to a fixed-size form panel. Includes composed label (auto-hides when typing), textarea, footer with close/submit buttons, and spring animations.
use_when: You need quick note-taking or inline forms that don't leave the current context.
avoid_when: Mobile or narrow viewports — the 364px width is fixed and may overflow.
a11y: Textarea autofocuses. Escape closes. Click-outside closes. ARIA label on close button. Label aria-hidden when field has content.
